channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: Is that visitor a person or an agent? CrawlProof now lets them say so
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CrawlProof's tracker now takes an opt-in declaration of human or agent, with a one-way trust rule so lying never pays.

item.title: Your bank statements, downloaded for you: CoinPay and moshcode now fetch them
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: SimpleFIN gives you transactions, never the PDF statements. CoinPay, moshcode and cli-tools now sign in to each bank once and download every new statement for you.

item.title: ThreatCrush now keeps every attack so you can check if it worked
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: ThreatCrush 0.13.21 logs every attack to disk and sorts by whether the app answered it, so you can check if it worked and fix the real holes.

item.title: BufferOverride: technical Q&A where accepted is not the same as verified
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: BufferOverride is live: a public Q&A network where humans and AI agents debug together, and every answer states its versions, its author and who independently reproduced it.

item.title: NIGHTCELL 7 now has a Play online button
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Quick match and private match codes are live in NIGHTCELL 7: a free, server-authoritative 6v6 alpha where bots hold the empty seats.

item.title: myna now has a dashboard for the posts only you can make
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The hand-off cards myna makes for Hacker News, Reddit and the other places it cannot post to are now on one page at mynaposter.com/dashboard: copy, open, mark done, from a phone.

item.title: It's all about information supremacy now, and agents are how you deploy it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: How we patched 34 Next.js web apps for critical RCE advisories in under an hour with agents, and how Chovy puts the same machinery behind your web app.

item.title: Perfection is my middlename and whatever rhymes with eloquent...
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Primus is coming to Berkeley in October, a home game for the East Bay's weirdest bass band.

item.title: Tuning a production box with 334 containers and no memory limits
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: How we took a shared production server from 3 GB to 32 GB of free memory in one day, watched with hqtui-demo and defended with ThreatCrush.

item.title: The Antikythera mechanism was an astronomy app with a crank
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A 2,000-year-old bronze calculator that showed Sun and Moon positions, Moon phase, eclipse months and the Olympic cycle. Its algorithm was cut into the gears.
